recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man in Western attire, framed by bold, oversized condensed typography that utilizes both horizontal and vertical orientations against a clean white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject is centered and overlaps the background typography
Red and black text blocks create a balanced frame around the subject
The vertical text on the right mirrors the height of the subject's torso
The subject's patterned shirt provides a high-contrast focal point against the flat text
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white striped shirt pattern
Black cowboy hat with a wide brim

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large silver belt buckle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red top-left text, moves down the black left-aligned text, across to the vertical red text on the right, and settles on the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space around the subject and between text blocks to maintain clarity despite large font sizes.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (Subject's hat, jeans, and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red and deep black against a neutral white for maximum legibility and impact.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic pairing of the same font family using color (Red and Black) and orientation (Horizontal and Vertical) to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, industrial sans-serif look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat, black jeans, and a black-and-white vertically striped western shirt with arms crossed, standing against a seamless white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add oversized, extra-condensed red and black sans-serif text. Place one red word at the top left, a black block of text stacked below it, and a single red word rotated 90 degrees clockwise along the right edge. Ensure the subject's hat and shoulders slightly overlap the text.

verificationChecks: Is the right-side text rotated 90 degrees?
Is the font extra-condensed and bold?
Does the subject overlap the text layers?

adjustableVariables: Specific pattern on the western shirt
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Any visible brand logos on the belt buckle or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for correct text orientation on the right margin
Ensure the red color is vibrant and not muted
Confirm the shirt pattern is sharp and high-contrast
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Oversized condensed sans-serif + Primary color accents + Vertical/Horizontal text mix.
